title: Electricity and Magnetism: Charges, Currents, and Fields

questions.question: Two positively charged spheres brought close together will:
questions.rationale: Like charges repel and unlike charges attract — the basic rule of electrostatics.

questions.question: A lightning conductor protects a building by:
options: Storing the charge inside the building
Offering the bolt a safe copper path into the ground
Attracting clouds away from the area
questions.rationale: Franklin's pointed metal spike gives the giant spark an easy, safe route to earth instead of through the walls.

questions.question: If 12 C of charge flows through a lamp in 4 s, the current is:
questions.rationale: I = Q/t = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 A, the lesson's worked example.

questions.question: Using Ohm's law, a 12 V battery across a 4 Ω lamp drives a current of:
questions.rationale: I = V/R = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 A at constant temperature.

questions.question: Two 6 Ω resistors connected in parallel give a total resistance of:
questions.rationale: 1/Rp = 1/6 + 1/6 = 1/3, so Rp = 3 Ω — parallel connection lowers the total resistance.

questions.question: In a series circuit, the current is:
questions.rationale: Series offers a single path, so the same current flows everywhere; it is the voltage that is shared.

questions.question: A fuse protects a circuit by:
options: Increasing the resistance of the wires
Melting and breaking the circuit when current exceeds its rating
questions.rationale: Joule heating (H = I²Rt) melts the fuse wire once the current crosses the rating, cutting off the supply.

questions.question: Electric bulb filaments are made of tungsten because it:
questions.rationale: Tungsten's extremely high melting point (≈ 3400 °C) lets the thin filament glow white-hot without melting.

questions.question: Hans Christian Oersted's 1820 discovery was that:
options: A current deflects a nearby compass needle
questions.rationale: Oersted saw the compass swivel beside a live wire, showing that every current produces a magnetic field.

questions.question: The earth wire in domestic wiring (green insulation) exists to:
options: Return the current to the meter
Bond appliance metal bodies to the ground for safety
questions.rationale: The earth wire keeps appliance bodies at ground potential, so even a live fault cannot give the user a shock.
